import "lib/github.com/diku-dk/sorts/merge_sort"

-- A year is a leap year if it divides by 4, but not by 100 unless by 400.
let divisible_by (year: i32) (n: i32): bool = year % n == 0

def is_leap (year: i32): bool =
  divisible_by year 4 && (!(divisible_by year 100) || divisible_by year 400)
